bio: Enjoy a quintessential English treat, and indulge your sweet tooth with The Ickworth's traditional Afternoon Tea.  With thier passion for food, the traditional Afternoon Tea has been lovingly crafted with a classic selection of finger sandwiches, homemade scones with preserve and clotted cream, alongside a selection of cakes and sweet treats. Your Afternoon Tea is served with your choice of Higgins loose-leaf tea or coffee.  Children's Afternoon Tea is also available priced at £15 per child, which features a selection of treats and is served alongside activity sheets for children to enjoy during service, or to continue the experience at home.  Sitting on the edge of Bury St. Edmunds, Ickworth House is a neoclassical country house boasting picturesque garden views. Formerly home to the Hervey family, the East Wing at The Ickworth has now been transformed into one of the most remarkable, family-friendly hotels the UK has ever seen.
